subject: Edge VPC traffic swap validation and runbook execution
messages:
From: Rachel Kim <rachel.kim@redwood.com>
To: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>, Alice Johnson <alice.johnson@acme-corp.com>, infra@acme-corp.com
Cc: 
Date: Sat, 29 May 2027 08:15:00 -0700
Subject: Edge VPC traffic swap validation and runbook execution

Hi team,

We have the agreed cutover window tomorrow (Sun 2027-05-30 02:00-03:00 UTC). Attached is the execution kit for the edge VPC traffic swap: runbook_v1.pdf and the smoke_checklist.csv. Key asks before we start: 

- Marcus: confirm KV cache priming sequence (desired: full prefix priming + 10m warm period).
- Laura: confirm telemetry routes (ingest -> observability cluster) are enabled and that the latency dashboard is sampling at 30s.
- Acme infra: confirm ACLs are in place for east-west control plane (ports 8443, 9090) and the maintenance window is still green on your side.

Plan summary (high-level):
1) Priming (00:30)
2) 1% sample swap (00:45) -> verify error rates and p95 latency
3) Ramp to 25% (01:00) -> validate throughput and KV miss rate
4) Full swap (01:30) if gates are green

Attachments: runbook_v1.pdf (runbook), smoke_checklist.csv (automated test list), priming-screenshot.png (example priming output).

If anything blocks, escalate to the on-call (ops) immediately. I will coordinate the post-run readout.

Thanks,
Rachel
Rachel Kim
Director, Private Deployments
Redwood Inference
From: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>
To: Rachel Kim <rachel.kim@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>
Cc: Alice Johnson <alice.johnson@acme-corp.com>, infra@acme-corp.com
Date: Sat, 29 May 2027 10:02:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Edge VPC traffic swap validation and runbook execution

Thanks Rachel — quick confirmation from infra/serving side.

- KV priming: I'll run the prefix priming job at T-30 and then perform a rapid read sweep for the top 1k prefixes. Expected warm window: ~8 minutes. I will post the priming summary to the shared drive link.
- Fallback: prepare an immediate rollback flag that removes the BGP next-hop on the new edge cluster; runbook includes the exact commands (page 7).
- Sampling approach: start at 1% for 15 minutes then evaluate error-rate delta and CPU util. If p95 increases > 40% or error rate > 0.5%, we abort and roll back.

Drive link to my preflight checklist: https://drive.google.com/open?id=1a2b3c-runbook-edge (see section 'Priming').

Subject: Re: Edge VPC traffic swap validation and runbook execution

Thanks Rachel — Acme infra confirms the maintenance window is aligned. A couple quick items from our side: 

- We'll monitor egress costs during the ramp; please alert if you see unexpected spikes.
- Fallback confirmation: if you initiate the rollback flag, our edge BGP will revert within 90s; we will also pause client-side retries for the first 2 minutes to avoid amplification.

One ask: can you include the exact alert names we should watch in our PagerDuty run (e.g., edge-serving-error-rate, edge-p95-latency)? If you paste them here I'll add them to our PD group.

Subject: Re: Edge VPC traffic swap validation and runbook execution

Status update (live):

- 02:00 UTC: Priming job completed. Priming log attached (priming-log.txt). Warm window observed: 7m 30s.
- 02:15 UTC: Initiated 1% sample traffic swap. Initial metrics:
  - p95 latency delta: +12% (within gate)
  - error rate: 0.12%
  - KV miss rate: 0.9%
  - CPU util on new edge nodes: 48%

All smoke probes passed in the first 15m. Keeping at 1% for another 10 minutes before ramp.

Subject: Re: Edge VPC traffic swap validation and runbook execution — post run readout

Final readout and action items: 

Outcome: Run completed successfully. We ramped from 1% -> 25% -> full over the window. All gates passed; no rollback required. Summary metrics attached to the Drive link.

Closed items:
- KV priming: confirmed. Warm window ~7-9 minutes (see priming-log.txt).
- Telemetry: ingestion steady, p95 within SLO after ramp.
- ACLs: no unexpected denies observed.
- Smoke tests: all checks in smoke_checklist.csv passed.

Follow-ups (owners + due dates):
- Marcus: bake the priming job as a scheduled preflight step (owner: marcus_lin) — target 2027-06-02
- Laura: add the edge-serving-error-rate and edge-p95-latency alerts to Acme PD group (owner: laura_bennett) — target 2027-06-01
- Docs: update runbook_v1.pdf with the exact rollback commands (owner: rachel_kim) — target 2027-06-03

Thanks to everyone for the coordinated execution. I'll file a short postmortem if anything interesting shows in the telemetry over the next 48h, but nothing immediate to report.

--
Rachel Kim
Director, Private Deployments
Redwood Inference
